line: Alsace-Lorraine changed hands four times between 1871 and 1945: each time someone tore off the paper and pasted a new piece, and the woman living on it never moved.
line_cn: 阿尔萨斯-洛林在 1871 到 1945 年间四次换主人：每次都有人撕下那块纸、贴上新的，住在上面的她一步没挪。

camera.serves: a claim; a build-up before a cut
a stamp; a slap; the heaviest blow of the film

camera.move: Pull back to the whole page
camera.serves: a reveal; a change of place; an ending

camera.move: Lateral slide into the next panel
camera.serves: a parallel scene; a quiet aside

camera.move: Whip across a gutter with speed lines

camera.expresses: the next row of the story
camera.serves: returning to the light after a dark panel

camera.move: Tilt down and push in until the map becomes a tabletop
camera.serves: layers of history; what is left underneath

transitions: Transitions are page moves only (slide, whip, drop, pull back);
no dissolves or flips between panels.
labels: Place names: an engraved small-caps serif (e.g. IM FELL English SC), tracked out, pure ink. No outline, glow or shadow.
Small print (tag captions, treaty slips, title card): the same family in roman and italic.

Every number (rule): a serif with lining figures (e.g. Old Standard TT). Old-style figures turn 1975 into "I975" and drop the 7 below the baseline. Year tags are bold lining figures with a thin printed rule under them; numbers inside other text switch to the lining face at the surrounding weight, on the same baseline, at about 0.9 of the surrounding size.
Shouts in speech bubbles: a round heavy display face (e.g. Lilita One), one English line; the Chinese line under it in a rounded hand-drawn face (e.g. ZCOOL KuaiLe) in the accent red.
motion: Puppets on twos (12 poses a second); camera and shadows move every frame.

Keyframes with spring overshoot: hop (legs swing, squat on landing), wind-up (lean back, tremble), strike (lunge, every joint rebounds), settle (arms crossed with overshoot). A head swap pops the head 1.07–1.10× for a frame or two.
One in-between drawing carries a big strike: the pose at the top holds and trembles, then a single frame with ink motion arcs lands it.
Impact spreads: the camera shakes, paper scraps fly, ink lines burst, the other puppet's hat jumps off and lands back.

native_moves.name: Cut along the dotted line
native_moves.does: A dashed cut line prints along the border, scissors snip along it, the cut land greys and hatches, a new patch drops with a big shadow and slaps down.
native_moves.fits: a company buying a rival's market; a district redrawn for an election; a river changing course and moving a border.

native_moves.name: Tear it back
native_moves.does: A patch is torn off with ragged fibres and leftover shreds underneath, and flung at the other puppet.
native_moves.fits: a treaty revoked; a franchise reclaimed; a merger undone.

native_moves.name: It won't lie flat
native_moves.does: A patch pressed on by force keeps a peeled corner; someone tugs it and it will not come off.
native_moves.fits: an occupation; a policy nobody accepts; a rebrand that doesn't stick.

native_moves.name: Layer on layer
native_moves.does: Instead of tearing, a new patch is pasted over the old ones, until the tilt-down shows a stack.
native_moves.fits: a city's successive names; layers of regulation; a product's version history.

native_moves.name: Stamp the papers
native_moves.does: A small civilian holds a document; a stamp drops in front of their face and changes one word.
native_moves.fits: a citizenship change; a visa rule; a currency switch.

native_moves.name: Pin on the map
native_moves.does: A labelled pin drops onto the real location to end a thread.
native_moves.fits: where a headquarters moved; where a battle ended; where a person still lives.

score.note: one instrument family per side: oom-pah tuba, accordion, xylophone steps
